title: Quantum Dot Device Configuration
description: Configuration for a one-dimensional quantum-dot device with parallel charge sensors, gate adjacency, safety limits, and DC wiring characteristics.

ScreeningGates.description: Semicolon-delimited list of all screening gates in the device.

PlungerGates.description: Semicolon-delimited list of all plunger gates in the device.

Ohmics.description: Semicolon-delimited list of all ohmic contacts in the device.

BarrierGates.description: Semicolon-delimited list of all barrier gates in the device.

ReservoirGates.description: Semicolon-delimited list of all reservoir gates in the device.

num-unique-channels.description: Number of unique readout channels represented by the configured groups.

groups.description: Mapping from group identifiers to quantum-dot group configurations. Slowly being desprecated in favor of adjacency representation.

adjacency.description: Mapping from a device connection to a semicolon-delimited list of directly adjacent connections. Adjacent connections only need to be listed once and the inverse is inferred.

max_safe_diff.description: Maximum permitted voltage difference between adjacent connections, in volts.

safe_voltage_bounds.description: Inclusive global voltage bounds in the form [minimum, maximum], in volts.

wiringDC.description: Mapping from each wired connection to its equivalent DC resistance and capacitance.

connectionName.description: Connection identifier beginning with a letter and containing only letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

gateList.description: A nonempty semicolon-delimited list of connection identifiers. Empty entries, whitespace, periods, leading semicolons, and trailing semicolons are not permitted.

connectionList.description: A nonempty semicolon-delimited list of adjacent connection identifiers.

Name.description: Unique logical name of the group, for example I_O1.

NumDots.description: Number of quantum dots in the group.

ScreeningGates.description: Screening gates associated with the group.

ReservoirGates.description: Reservoir gates associated with the group.

PlungerGates.description: Plunger gates associated with the group.

BarrierGates.description: Barrier gates associated with the group.

Order.description: Physical connection order for the group, normally beginning and ending with ohmic contacts.
